prompt: Add Round to pixels to the palette, so icons come out crisp: afterwards the selected layers' X, Y, W and H are all whole numbers. It works on everything selected, including the layers inside selected groups and frames, and one Undo puts them all back.
reference: Rounds each layer's left, top, right and bottom edges and takes width and height from the rounded edges, in one resize command, so layers that touched still touch.

naive.summary: Rounds x, y, width and height each on its own, which opens a 1 px gap between shapes that met at a half pixel.
